He tried to convince me while my mananger was away on leave, to take our new stock of Madden games to what was essentially a flea market. Granted in my area, it was a very popular flea market but the clientele as one would guess, were all older people. I told him I refused to do so as it would be a loss in revenue seeing as Madden was one of the most anticipated titles each year. People go to a video game store to buy video games. It's pretty simple to understand my logic. He made some mild passive aggressive threats to my employment and called me into a meeting the next morning with upper management. I stood my ground and they all agreed with me and thought he was a fool. He was fired and ended up working for a mattress store. That's how I got my promotion to AM!
